name: When do I need gas line isolation or capping services?

mainEntity.name: When do I need gas line isolation or capping services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need gas line isolation or capping when you have a gas leak, are removing a gas appliance (like a stove or dryer), are undertaking renovations that affect gas lines, or if a section of your gas line is damaged. It's crucial to address these issues promptly to prevent dangerous gas leaks and ensure the safety of your property. If you suspect a leak, evacuate immediately and call your gas provider and a licensed plumber.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need gas line isolation or capping when there's a gas leak, removing an appliance, renovating, or if a gas line section is damaged.
